criteria.label: prefer clear resolution wording
criteria.operator_check: Market wording should clearly name the event, source concept, measurement, and settlement condition before pilot selection.

criteria.label: prefer identifiable official source
criteria.operator_check: A future operator should be able to name the likely official source type before any network fetch is attempted.

criteria.label: prefer near/mid-term markets
criteria.operator_check: First pilots should avoid distant or stale markets where source pages and wording are more likely to drift.

criteria.label: avoid ambiguous/meme/private-person/legal/medical rumor-driven markets for first pilots
criteria.operator_check: First pilots should avoid markets driven by vague memes, private-person rumors, legal allegations, medical claims, or hard-to-verify informal sources.

criteria.label: order: esports, weather, crypto
criteria.operator_check: Future pilot testing should run esports first, weather second, and crypto third.

excluded_first_pilot_market_types: markets without an identifiable official source type
